answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of its task data and a future drand threshold-BLS beacon pulse; the revealed pulse selects hidden parameters that must be incorporated into the response. Thus an automated swarm cannot precompute valid answers, rank cheap identities, or farm offline without the unpredictable value. Commit-reveal timing and beacon signatures make results publicly verifiable, while mesa, island, and summit instances remain equally bound to the same unbiased entropy.
